post.description: If current user has no permission to add (`invite`) someone - that user will not be added.Response contains profiles of actually added users.

delete.description: Delete a Channel for the current user or for all users.

post.summary: Find Channels by partial match, category, paid status with pagination
post.description:
Only for public Channels.
Supports filtering and pagination.

200.description: A paginated list of channels found

get.description:
Does not include list of participants and info about Last messages.
Also includes current user permissions for Channel info/config operations.

post.description:
Update info of a Channel. Set Name, UserName & Avatar.
Function available only for Admins with `editGroup` permission.
NOTE: there is no way to set an empty filed.
NOTE: The uniqueness of the username is checked before change.
NOTE: If `category` is provided - it will `replace` current category of the channel.

Add users to a Channel.
Users can prevent themselves from being added by setting privacy settings.
Function available only for Admins with `inviteUsers` permission or if Channel is not Private and has `allowAddUsers` enabled.
Response returns number of actually added users.

get.description:
Get list of Channel members (in portions, starting from `startPos` index).
Response can be filtered by firstName, lastName, username.
NOTE: Privacy settings is applied to Users profiles on return.
NOTE: only chat/group members can see members list.
NOTE: some profiles may have `isAdmin` flag - mark for current Group Admin
NOTE: could be queried via WS with `participants` request

delete.description:
Function available only for Admins with `editGroup` permission.
Admin can remove another Admin if he has `makeAdmin` permission.
Number of really removed user is returned in response.

post.description:
Remove users from a Channel.
Removed subscribers will not be able to view the Channel and can rejoin it only after being unbanned.
.

200.description: Users removed from the Channel successfully

post.description:
Permit access to Channel for banned users.
Users should join the channel.
.

get.description: Get the list of removed (banned) Channel members.

post.description:
User can Join directly (providing chatId) or by using Invite Link (by its ID).
If join is successful - `chatId` returned in response.
If invite link requires an Admin approval - than response has 202 status code.
If invite link is expired or uses limit reached - 404 error response.

202.description: Join request is waiting for Approval

404.description: linkId is not valid or link is expired

post.description: Owner can leave Channel or can Delegate it first (in that case set new Owner in `newOwnerId`)

get.description:
Admin should have `inviteUsers` permission to get Links.
Or Channel should have `allowAddUsers` enabled.

post.description:
If no ID provided - link is created.
If ID provided in request - worker will try to Edit existing link.
Invite link can have Time-to-live `ttl` in Seconds.
About users join approval see **/channel/pendingJoins** and **/channel/pending**.

delete.description:
When link revoked successfully - empty object is returned.
But if it was the last Link - a new one is generated and its ID is returned.

get.summary: Get pending join requests in Channels
get.description: Admin should have `inviteUsers` permission to get list of pending join requests.

post.summary: Process pending requests to send messages in Private Channels
post.description:
Admin should have `inviteUsers` permission to get process pending join requests.
Returns number of approved requests.
If request is not approved - it will remain in pending list until will be approved or user is removed from the Channel.

get.description:
Full list of Admins is available only to Owner & other admins.
Other users can find Admins in users list by `isAdmin` flag.
NOTE: could be queried via WS with `administrators` request.

post.summary: Add administrators to Channel or change permissions of existing.
post.description:
Assigner should have `makeAdmin` permission.
Assigner cannot change some permission of another Admin if he himself does not have this permission.

delete.description:
Remover should have `makeAdmin` permission.
Number of really removed Admins is returned in response.
Deleted administrators remain in the user list of the Channel.

post.description:
Admin should have `editGroup` permission to set Allowe Reactions.
Pass object with `undefined` reactions - to enable reactions to messages in the Group
Pass an empty array `[]` in `reactions` param to disable any Reaction.
Pass reactions list `["👍", "❤️"]` in `reactions` param to append them to Currently allowed.
If you need to Replace current allowed reaction - first make this call with an empty or undefined list

get.description:
Reactions `undefined` - means all reactions are possible for messages in the Channel
Empty array `[]` in `reactions` - no allowed Reaction.
Reactions list `["👍", "❤️"]` in `reactions` - Currently allowed list of reactions.

post.description: Function available only for Admins with `editGroup` permission.

Owner can purge all messages from Channel.
Any user can purge messages for himself.
Flag `forAll` has no effect when used by User or even Admin
After messages being Purged `purgedMessages` event be sent to Users.

post.summary: Transfer Channel ownership to a new Owner
post.description:
Only the Owner can transfer Ownership.
New Owner should be a Member of the Channel.

post.summary: Make Channel paid/unpaid and set payment settings
post.description: Only the Admin with `payments` permission can change these settings.

query.description: Text to search for in messages

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return

startDate.description: Start of Date interval in milliseconds

endDate.description: End of Date interval in milliseconds
